en.headline: Marine Department probes yacht that sped at rowers near High Island
en.dek: A rower in Saturday’s Sai Kung Coastal Challenge said a yacht accelerated towards his boat in a deliberate act; the department will investigate even without a formal report.
body: The Marine Department has opened an investigation after a yacht allegedly sped directly towards a boat carrying six rowers during a race near High Island Reservoir in Sai Kung on Saturday.

Eddie Lam Yat-ming, an assistant professor at Hong Kong Metropolitan University and one of the participants in the 40-kilometre Sai Kung Coastal Challenge, posted video footage on social media on Sunday. The clip showed a blue-and-white yacht passing close to the rowing boat at high speed, causing it to rock violently in the wake.

Lam wrote that the yacht accelerated from about 100 metres away with its bow pointed at the team. He described the manoeuvre as deliberate and warned that such behaviour could cost lives, urging boat operators to respect the safety of athletes on the water.

In response to media inquiries on Monday, a Marine Department spokeswoman said the department had not received any reports of the incident but would proactively investigate. She added that appropriate action would be taken if any breach of the law was found.

Under the International Regulations for the Prevention of Collisions at Sea, power-driven vessels are required to give way to vessels under oars or sail. Hong Kong’s Shipping and Port Control Ordinance provides for a maximum penalty of four years’ imprisonment and a fine of HK$200,000 for endangering the safety of persons on board a vessel or in the sea.

zh.headline: 西貢破邊洲附近遊艇高速逼近划艇 海事處主動調查
zh.dek: 周六西貢海岸挑戰賽期間，一名划艇手指遊艇刻意加速直衝其船，海事處周一表示即使未接獲舉報亦會主動調查。
body: 海事處已就一宗遊艇涉嫌高速逼近划艇事件展開調查。事發於上周六西貢萬宜水庫附近舉行的40公里西貢海岸挑戰賽期間。
香港都會大學助理教授林一鳴是參賽者之一，他周日在社交平台上載片段，顯示一艘藍白相間的遊艇高速近距離掠過其六人划艇，船身因船尾波浪劇烈搖晃。
林一鳴形容遊艇從約100米外突然加速，船頭直指划艇隊，認為此舉並非意外而是刻意行為，並警告此類行為可能危及性命，呼籲船隻操作者尊重水上運動員安全。
海事處發言人周一回覆傳媒查詢時表示，部門未有接獲相關事故報告，但會主動展開調查；若發現任何違法行為，將採取適當行動。
根據國際避碰規則，動力船隻須讓路予靠人力或風力驅動的船隻。香港《船舶及港口管制條例》訂明，危害船上或海中人士安全者，最高可判監禁四年及罰款20萬元。
